16421095.verdict: 賽前看好 Deportivo 主勝（46%）方向正確，但比分、半場和黃牌都低估；半場時因 Osasuna 領先改看客勝 57%，反而判斷錯了。
points: 勝負方向命中：Deportivo 控球 62%、xG 2.36 對 1.1、射正 7 對 2，全場壓制明顯，2-1 逆轉是合理結果；預測的 1-0 偏保守，總進球 3 球也超過市場看好的小 2.5 球。
半場 0-0 沒有命中：Budimir 第 32 分鐘把握住 Osasuna 少數的機會；這種單次終結模型看不到，但上半場 Deportivo 已經佔優。
半場更新把客勝調到 57% 是最大失誤：過度看重比分，忽略了 Deportivo 的控球、射門優勢和 Osasuna 作客場均失 3.4 球的弱點；下半場主隊果然進了 2 球。
數據偏差：Deportivo 角球 8 個（預測 5.6），Osasuna 只有 2 個（預測 3.8），說明一方壓制時角球會往強勢方集中；Osasuna 犯規 13 次符合預測，黃牌 4 張高於預測的 2.6，Deportivo 卻是 0 張黃牌、只犯規 5 次（預測 12）。
16421095.lesson: 半場落後的一方如果 xG、射門和控球明顯佔優，半場更新不要大幅改看領先方，應該保留壓制方追平或逆轉的機率；同時要預期角球和犯規都會向單邊傾斜。
16421095.verdict_en: The pre-match lean to a Deportivo home win (46%) was right, but the scoreline, half-time call and cards were all too low. At half-time the update swung to an Osasuna win at 57%, which turned out wrong.
points_en: The result direction was correct. Deportivo dominated with 62% possession, xG 2.36 vs 1.1 and shots on target 7 vs 2, so the 2-1 comeback made sense. The predicted 1-0 was too cautious, and 3 total goals beat the market's under-2.5 lean.

The 0-0 half-time call missed because Budimir took one of Osasuna's few chances in the 32nd minute. The model can't see a one-off finish like that, but Deportivo were already on top in the first half.

The half-time update to 57% for Osasuna was the biggest error. It leaned too hard on the scoreline and ignored Deportivo's possession and shot advantage, plus Osasuna's away weakness (3.4 goals conceded per game). Deportivo scored twice after the break.

Stat misses: Deportivo won 8 corners (5.6 predicted) and Osasuna only 2 (3.8 predicted), so corners piled up on the dominant side. Osasuna's 13 fouls matched the forecast, but they got 4 yellows vs 2.6 predicted. Deportivo committed only 5 fouls (12 predicted) and got no cards.
16421095.lesson_en: If the team trailing at half-time clearly leads on xG, shots and possession, don't swing the half-time update hard toward the leading side. Keep real odds of an equaliser or comeback, and expect corners and fouls to tilt toward one side.

16421101.verdict: Barcelona 客勝方向猜中，最可能比分 1-2 也完全命中，但半場 0-0 沒猜中，黃牌也比預測少。
points: 勝平負給 Barcelona 47% 最高，最終 2-1 客勝，首選比分 1-2 正確
半場預測 0-0，實際 10 分鐘 Simeone 就早早進球，F. López 在 45 分鐘扳平，兩隊上半場都比預想更開放
雖然 Alberola Rojas 吹罰嚴格，全場只有 4 張黃牌（預測 4.8），犯規 28 次也比他平均的 32 次少
角球只有 6 個，遠低於預測的 9.6；Atlético Madrid 控球只有 37%，Barcelona 控球 63% 卻只有 2 個角球，射門多但很少從邊路製造角球
16421101.lesson: In big-team head-to-heads, don't apply the referee's season card average directly, and shade corners down, especially when Barcelona lack wide starters.
16421101.verdict_en: Barcelona away win and the 1-2 top scoreline were both correct, but the 0-0 half-time call missed and cards came in under the forecast.
points_en: Barcelona were favourites at 47% and won 2-1; the top scoreline 1-2 was exact
Half-time 0-0 missed: Simeone scored on 10' and F. López equalised on 45', so the first half was more open than expected
Despite strict referee Alberola Rojas, there were only 4 yellows (forecast 4.8) and 28 fouls, below his 32 average
Corners totalled just 6 vs 9.6 forecast; Barcelona had 63% possession but only 2 corners

16421102.verdict: 賽前判斷 Real Betis 客勝正確，半場 0-0 也預測對了，但全場比分 0-2 不在前三個預測比分裡；角球和黃牌大幅低估，半場後轉向平局的調整也是錯的。
points: 賽前給客勝 50%，最終 Real Betis 0-2 獲勝，方向正確；不過兩個進球都在 81 分鐘以後，前三個預測比分（1-1、1-2、0-1）都沒有命中。
角球偏差最大：預測 4.8 對 4.6，實際 9 對 8，總數 17 個，大約是預測的兩倍；上半場就已經有 8 個，兩隊都大量從邊路進攻和傳中。
黃牌：預測 Elche 2.7 張，實際 4 張，全部在下半場，因為 Elche 落後追分時犯規增多；Real Betis 0 張，比預測的 1.9 張少，上半場預測的 1.5 張黃牌也一張沒出。
半場時根據 Elche 的 xG 優勢（1.05 對 0.37）把平局調高到 41%，結果下半場 Real Betis 射正 9 次、壓制明顯，半場的 xG 差距不能代表 Real Betis 的實力。
16421102.lesson: 半場 0-0 時，不要因為上半場 xG 落後就大幅降低強隊的勝率；另外中下游球隊主場對強隊時，角球基準應該上調。
16421102.verdict_en: The pre-match call of a Real Betis away win was right, and so was the 0-0 half-time, but the 0-2 final score was not among the top three predicted scores. Corners and cards were badly underestimated, and the half-time shift towards a draw was wrong.
points_en: Real Betis were given 50% before kick-off and won 0-2, so the direction was right. Both goals came after the 81st minute, though, so none of the top three scores (1-1, 1-2, 0-1) hit.

Corners were the biggest miss: predicted 4.8 vs 4.6, actual 9 vs 8. The total of 17 was about double the forecast, and 8 had already come in the first half because both teams attacked down the flanks and crossed a lot.

Cards: Elche were forecast 2.7 and got 4, all in the second half, as fouls rose once they were chasing the game. Real Betis got 0 against a forecast of 1.9, and none of the 1.5 first-half cards that were predicted came.

At half-time the draw was raised to 41% on Elche's xG edge (1.05 vs 0.37). In the second half Real Betis had 9 shots on target and clearly dominated, so the first-half xG gap did not reflect their quality.
16421102.lesson_en: At 0-0 at half-time, don't sharply cut the favourite's win chance because of a first-half xG deficit. Also raise the corners baseline when a lower-table home side faces a stronger team.
16421102._note: This is a post-match review for reference only, not betting advice.

16421103.verdict: 勝平負沒有猜中，但 Racing Club 1-2 客勝是第二順位比分；半場 0-0 和全場犯規、黃牌都偏離很大，Aznou 64 分鐘兩黃變一紅是轉折點。
points: 賽前客勝 34% 只比主勝低一點，比分第二選項 1-2 猜中；半場檢討因 Málaga 1-0 領先，把主勝調高到 63%，結果被逆轉，半場的調整過度跟隨比分。
半場比分沒有猜中：Málaga 28 分鐘先進球，實際雙方 xG 合計 4.39、射正 15 次，比賽遠比「Málaga 保守 5-3-2」的預期開放。
黃牌是最大偏差：預測 2.6 比 2.8，實際 6 比 2 外加一張紅牌，全集中在 Málaga；犯規也是 Málaga 11 次、Racing Club 只有 5 次，預測的 13.6 嚴重高估了 Racing Club 的犯規。
角球大致準確：Málaga 6 次（預測 5.8），Racing Club 3 次（預測 4.4）；Málaga 少一人後仍然有攻勢，模型看不到紅牌之後的場面變化。
16421103.lesson: 裁判黃牌多、又是護級戰時，要考慮黃牌集中在落後或比較被動的一方，以及兩黃變一紅的風險；半場領先的弱隊不要太快把勝率調得太高。
16421103.verdict_en: 1X2 call missed, but Racing Club's 1-2 away win was our second scoreline pick; the 0-0 half-time call, fouls and cards were well off, and Aznou's 64' second yellow was the turning point.
points_en: Pre-match the away win (34%) was only slightly below the home win and 1-2 was our second scoreline; at half-time we raised the Málaga win to 63% after their 1-0 lead and they were overturned, so the half-time update leaned too much on the score.
Half-time 0-0 missed: Málaga scored in the 28th minute, and the game was far more open than the 'defensive Málaga 5-3-2' read suggested (combined xG 4.39, 15 shots on target).
Cards were the biggest miss: we predicted 2.6 vs 2.8, the actual was 6 vs 2 plus a red, all on Málaga's side; fouls were 11 vs 5, so we badly overestimated Racing Club's fouls at 13.6.
Corners were roughly right: Málaga 6 (pred 5.8), Racing Club 3 (pred 4.4); the model can't see how the game changed after the red card, when 10-man Málaga still kept attacking.
16421103.lesson_en: With a card-heavy referee in a relegation battle, expect the cards to pile up on the more reactive or trailing side, and allow for a second-yellow red; don't push a weak side's win probability too high just because it leads at half-time.

16421104.verdict: Celta 壓制的判斷正確，但 xG 3.04 對 0.22 也沒有進球，最終 0-0；這是終結能力的問題，主勝 50% 沒有兌現。
points: 賽前首選 1-0 主勝，0-0 平局只在半場更新中排第一；半場把平局提高到 39% 是合理的修正
Celta 射門 23 次、射正 8 次、xG 3.04 仍然沒有進球，Levante 門將表現出色加上運氣，模型無法預見
犯規只有 17 次，預測 24.2 偏高很多；黃牌 3 張則接近預測的 3.8
角球 7 個比預測的 8.2 略少，Celta 下半場拿到 4 個角球，但 Levante 幾乎沒有角球（1 個）
16421104.lesson: Keep enough 0-0 probability in one-sided games—dominance isn't goals—and don't over-forecast fouls in wet, windy conditions.
16421104.verdict_en: Celta dominated as expected but drew 0-0 despite 3.04 xG to 0.22; finishing failed and the 50% home win didn't come in.
points_en: Pre-match top pick was 1-0; 0-0 only topped the half-time update, and raising the draw to 39% at HT was a sensible correction
Celta had 23 shots, 8 on target and 3.04 xG yet didn't score—goalkeeping and luck the model can't see
Fouls were only 17 vs 24.2 forecast; 3 yellows were close to the 3.8 forecast
Corners 7 vs 8.2 forecast; Levante managed just 1

16421105.verdict: 勝負方向判斷正確（Real Madrid 勝的機率給了 72%），但比分和半場比分都低估了 Real Madrid 的優勢；犯規和黃牌嚴重低估，角球則估多了。
points: 賽果判斷正確，但實際比分 0-3 不在前三個預測比分內；半場預測 0-1，實際 0-2，Valverde 28 分鐘、Güler 36 分鐘兩個進球讓比賽很早就定了局。
偏差最大的是犯規：Valencia 預測 13 次，實際 26 次（上半場就有 13 次）；Real Madrid 預測 9.5 次，實際只有 6 次。主隊密集防守，長時間只有 32% 控球，只能一直靠犯規阻止對手。
黃牌預測合共約 4 張，實際 7 張加 1 張紅牌。上半場黃牌（1-1）預測得準，多出來的牌主要在 79 至 81 分鐘：Gayà 被紅牌罰下後，比賽情緒失控，兩隊 3 分鐘內又吃了 4 張黃牌。
角球預測 10 個，實際只有 7 個（2 比 5）：Real Madrid 雖然射門 19 次、射正 11 次，但多數是禁區內直接射門，沒有轉化成角球；Valencia 幾乎沒有進攻，只有 2 個角球。
16421105.lesson: 弱隊主場擺密集防守，對手又佔絕對控球優勢時，弱隊的犯規要明顯上調（可接近翻倍），強隊的犯規要下調；一方早早大比分領先時，要考慮比賽後段因情緒失控而多出來的紅黃牌。
16421105.verdict_en: The direction was right (Real Madrid win at 72%), but the full-time and half-time scores understated Real Madrid's dominance. Fouls and cards were badly underestimated, and corners were overestimated.
points_en: The result was right, but the actual 0-3 was not among the top three predicted scores. We predicted 0-1 at half-time and it was 0-2: goals from Valverde (28') and Güler (36') settled the game early.

Fouls were the biggest miss. Valencia were predicted at 13 and committed 26 (13 in the first half alone); Real Madrid were predicted at 9.5 and committed only 6. With a low block and just 32% possession, the home side could only stop Real Madrid by fouling.

We predicted about 4 yellow cards in total; there were 7 yellows plus a red. First-half cards (1-1) were accurate. The extra cards came between 79' and 81': after Gayà's red card the game boiled over and four more yellows followed within three minutes.
We predicted 10 corners and there were 7 (2-5). Real Madrid had 19 shots and 11 on target, but most were direct shots in the box rather than corners, and Valencia barely attacked, winning only 2.
16421105.lesson_en: When a weak home side sits in a low block against a team with dominant possession, raise the weak side's fouls sharply (close to double) and lower the stronger side's fouls. When one team builds a big early lead, allow for extra late cards as tempers flare.

16421106.verdict: 比分 1-1（首選比分）和半場 0-0 都猜中，主要賽果判斷合格；不過勝平負給 Athletic Club 45% 最高，平局只有 28%，Osasuna 的犯規也明顯低估了。
points: Athletic Club xG 2.09 對 0.65，機會品質完全佔優，客隊佔優的判斷方向正確；可是 N. Williams 84 分鐘才進球，Catena 90 分鐘就扳平，最後是平局。
Osasuna 犯規 19 次，預測只有 13.8；控球只有 39% 的主隊在 derby 裡靠犯規破壞對手進攻，這是偏差最大的一項。Athletic Club 犯規 10 次，比預測略少。
角球總數 10 個，預測 9.4，總量很接近，但分佈反了：Osasuna 射門 17 次，多數是低品質的遠射和傳中，拿到 6 個角球；預測卻是客隊角球較多。
黃牌 3-1，總數 4 張，預測 4.9，大致合理；半場檢討把平局提高到 39.5%，方向正確。
16421106.lesson: 主場弱隊控球少但射門多時，犯規和角球都要往主隊方向調高；xG 佔優的客隊如果一直沒能早進球，平局機率要給得更高一些。
16421106.verdict_en: Correct-score pick 1-1 and HT 0-0 both landed, so the result call was solid; but Athletic Club were the 45% favourite with the draw only at 28%, and Osasuna's fouls were clearly underestimated.
points_en: Athletic Club dominated chance quality (xG 2.09 vs 0.65), so the away-edge read was right; but N. Williams only scored in the 84th minute and Catena equalised in the 90th, so it ended level.

Osasuna committed 19 fouls vs 13.8 predicted: with only 39% possession, the home side broke up play with fouls in the derby. This was the biggest miss. Athletic Club had 10 fouls, slightly fewer than predicted.

Total corners (10) were close to the predicted 9.4, but the split was reversed: Osasuna's 17 shots, mostly low-quality long shots and crosses, earned them 6 corners, while we expected the away side to win more.
Cards (3-1, 4 total vs 4.9) were roughly right; the half-time update raising the draw to 39.5% went the right way.
16421106.lesson_en: When a home underdog has little possession but takes lots of shots, push fouls and corners up for the home side; if the xG-dominant away team can't score early, give the draw more weight.

16421107.verdict: 賽前預測主勝53%方向正確，1-0也在三個比分選項之內，半場0-0說中；角球和黃牌接近實際，犯規則明顯高估。
points: 賽果方向和比分都說中：賽前主勝53%，1-0列在第三個比分選項；半場檢討後把主勝下調到37.6%、平局升到40.4%，對上半場沒有射正的反應過度，最後仍是 Real Sociedad 取勝。
雙方xG 1.42比1.35、射正同為3次，比賽其實勢均力敵；主隊靠 Óskarsson 第67分鐘的進球取勝，帶有一定運氣成分。主勝53%偏高，Rayo Vallecano 作客差的數據沒有在這場體現。
角球主隊7個完全命中，客隊實際6個，預測只有4.3，低估了 Rayo Vallecano 的進攻參與；上半場角球3比2，也接近預測的3.6比1.6。
犯規預測13.3比11.2，實際只有11比8，整體高估約5次；黃牌合計實際4張，預測4.7張，基本準確，裁判 Juan Martinez Munuera 這場比他的場均3.5張略多一點。
16421107.lesson: 半場0-0而且xG接近時，不要因為主隊上半場沒有射正就大幅調低主勝；對休息充足的客隊，角球預測要調高一點，犯規基準也應該下調。
16421107.verdict_en: Pre-match call was right: home win at 53%, with 1-0 among the three scorelines, and 0-0 at half-time also correct. Corners and cards were close; fouls were clearly overestimated.
points_en: Result and score were both right: home win at 53% pre-match, 1-0 as the third scoreline option. The half-time update cut the home win to 37.6% and raised the draw to 40.4%, an overreaction to the first half having no shots on target; Real Sociedad still won.

xG was 1.42 vs 1.35 and shots on target 3 each, so the game was close to even. Real Sociedad won through Óskarsson's 67' goal, partly luck. 53% for the home win looks too high, and Rayo Vallecano's poor away record did not show in this game.
Home corners (7) were exactly right, but Rayo Vallecano took 6 against a prediction of 4.3, so their attacking play was underestimated. First-half corners went 3-2, close to the predicted 3.6-1.6.

Fouls were predicted at 13.3 vs 11.2; the actual 11 vs 8 means about 5 too many in total. Cards were 4 in total against a predicted 4.7, broadly accurate, with referee Juan Martinez Munuera showing slightly more than his 3.5 per-game average.
16421107.lesson_en: At 0-0 at half-time with similar xG, don't cut the home win sharply just because the home side had no shots on target in the first half. Raise the corner estimate a little for a well-rested away side, and lower the foul baseline.

16421108.verdict: 賽前 1X2 傾向 Espanyol 小勝，首選比分 1-1，都沒有猜中，但半場 0-0 和犯規數猜得準；半場更新改為平局 40%、0-0 首選，命中最終結果。
points: 結果：賽前給 Espanyol 勝 40%，最終 0-0 平局；半場更新把平局提高到 40%、首選比分改為 0-0，判斷正確。
角球偏差最大：預測 Espanyol 3.5 個，實際 9 個（上半場只有 1 個，下半場 8 個）。Espanyol 控球 64%，下半場一直壓上進攻，模型用的是他們本季主場平均（1.4 個），沒有考慮到這種一邊倒的局面。
黃牌低估：預測合計約 5.2 張，實際 8 張，其中 6 張出現在第 73 分鐘之後。0-0 膠著到最後，雙方搶得很兇，裁判頻繁出牌；上半場黃牌（1-1）和犯規（17-10 對預測 15-11）則大致準確。
Deportivo 上半場角球 4 個、機會也較好，但全場只有 1 次射正。Espanyol 雖然控球佔優，xG 只有 0.68，屬於控球多、威脅少的比賽，平局是合理結果。
16421108.lesson: 雙方實力接近、市場三種結果很平均時，平局和低比分（0-0）的機率要給高一點；控球明顯佔優的主隊，角球預測要往上調，不能只看他們本季主場的平均角球；比分膠著時，黃牌要預估比平均更多（主要集中在最後 20 分鐘）。
16421108.verdict_en: Pre-match lean to an Espanyol win with 1-1 as the top score missed, but the 0-0 half-time call and the foul counts were accurate; the half-time update (draw 40%, 0-0 top pick) got the final result right.
points_en: Result: Espanyol win was given 40% pre-match, but it ended 0-0; the half-time update raised the draw to 40% with 0-0 as the top score, which was correct.

Biggest miss was corners: Espanyol were predicted 3.5 and took 9 (1 in the first half, 8 in the second). With 64% possession they pushed forward for the whole second half, and the model relied on their season home average (1.4), missing the one-sided game state.
Cards were underestimated: about 5.2 predicted vs 8 actual, 6 of them after the 73rd minute as a tight 0-0 got scrappy late on. First-half cards (1-1) and fouls (17-10 vs 15-11 predicted) were close.

Deportivo had more first-half corners (4) and the better chances but managed only 1 shot on target. Espanyol dominated the ball with just 0.68 xG, a sterile possession game where a draw was a fair result.
16421108.lesson_en: When two sides are evenly matched and the market splits the three outcomes almost equally, give the draw and low scores (0-0) more weight. Raise the corner forecast for a home side expected to dominate possession instead of relying on its season home average. Expect extra cards in tight, level games, mostly in the last 20 minutes.

16421109.verdict: 主勝方向沒有應驗，0-0 平局。Sevilla 壓制明顯（xG 1.58 對 0.54），但把握機會太差；半場更新時把平局機率提高到 40%，並把 0-0 列為首選比分，修正方向正確。
points: Sevilla 控球 60%、射門 13 次，卻只有 3 次射正。Alavés 本季作客進攻疲弱，這點預測對了，但 Sevilla 本身的鋒線火力不足，被低估了：缺少 Miguel Sierra 和 P. Fernández 之後，進攻厚度確實不夠。
犯規偏差最大：預測 Alavés 犯規 13 次，實際 19 次，而且上半場就有 10 次。客隊長時間被壓著打，靠犯規限制對手，加上裁判 Bestard 判罰尺度較嚴，全場犯規 33 次，比預測的 27 次多。
黃牌總數 4 張，接近預測的 5.1 張，但分布偏向 Alavés（3 張對 1 張）。預測主隊 2.8 張明顯偏高，被壓制的一方通常才是吃牌較多的一方。
角球 5 對 4，總數 9 個，接近預測。上半場只有 1 對 1，低於預測的 3.6 個，Sevilla 的控球優勢沒有轉成角球。
16421109.lesson: 主隊控球佔優但缺少前鋒輪換，客隊又以防守為主時，應提高平局和小比分（0-0、1-0）的機率；黃牌和犯規要多分配給被壓制的客隊。
16421109.verdict_en: The home-win call missed: it ended 0-0. Sevilla dominated (xG 1.58 vs 0.54) but finished poorly. The half-time update, which raised the draw to 40% and made 0-0 the top score, was the right correction.
points_en: Sevilla had 60% possession and 13 shots but only 3 on target. Alavés' weak away attack was read correctly, but Sevilla's own lack of firepower without Miguel Sierra and P. Fernández was underrated.

Fouls were the biggest miss: Alavés committed 19 vs 13 predicted (10 in the first half alone). Pinned back for long spells, they fouled to slow Sevilla down, and with a strict referee in Bestard the total reached 33 vs 27 predicted.
4 yellow cards was close to the 5.1 predicted, but they were skewed to Alavés (3-1). The home forecast of 2.8 was too high; the side under pressure usually collects the cards.
Corners finished 5-4 (9 total), close to the forecast, but the first half had only 1-1 vs 3.6 predicted. Sevilla's possession did not turn into corners.
16421109.lesson_en: When a possession-heavy home side lacks forward depth against a defensive visitor, raise draw and low-score (0-0, 1-0) probabilities, and assign more fouls and cards to the side being pinned back.

16421110.verdict: Villarreal 主勝和首選比分 2-0 之一都命中，半場 0-0 也猜中，是準確度很高的一場；主要偏差是 Getafe 的犯規和黃牌比預想少。
points: 主勝 63% 正確，2-0 是第二選比分，半場 0-0 也正確；兩個進球都在 80 分鐘後才出現
角球 13 個（9 對 4）比預測的 10.5 多，Villarreal 控球 72% 加上下半場 Getafe 必須進攻，角球偏多
Getafe 只有 2 張黃牌、13 次犯規，比預測的 3.4 張少；Muniz 吹罰寬鬆的判斷比 Bordalás 球隊的風格更準
Villarreal 只有 6 次犯規卻拿到 2 張黃牌，比預測的 2.0 剛好一樣
16421110.lesson: Push corners up when a strong side faces a purely defensive opponent, and weight the referee's season card average over team reputation.
16421110.verdict_en: Villarreal win, the 2-0 scoreline (2nd pick) and 0-0 at half-time were all correct; the main miss was Getafe's fouls and cards coming in lower than expected.
points_en: 63% home win correct, 2-0 was the 2nd scoreline pick and HT 0-0 hit; both goals came after 80'
Corners were 13 (9-4) vs 10.5 forecast, with 72% Villarreal possession and Getafe chasing late
Getafe got only 2 yellows and 13 fouls vs 3.4 forecast; referee Muniz's lenient profile beat Bordalás's reputation
Villarreal's 2 yellows from just 6 fouls matched the 2.0 forecast

16421112.verdict: 賽果完全看錯：主勝 63% 的熱門最後 0-1 輸球。主隊場面佔優但沒能進球，Espanyol 守住後靠一次機會偷走勝利。
points: 勝負方向錯：主勝 63%、客勝只有 14%。Athletic Club 的 xG 是 1.17 對 0.46，射門 16 對 6，場面上的優勢確實存在，問題是沒有終結能力。賽前提到的缺 Guruzeta、Sannadi 兩名中鋒，結果比預期更致命。
半場 0-0 預測正確；半場檢討把平局提高到 39%、首選比分改為 0-0，方向是對的，但仍低估了客隊反擊進球的可能。
角球預測 7-3，實際 9-2，主隊壓制比預期更強，符合「一方主導時角球被低估」的已知偏差。上半場角球 3-2 則與預測接近。
犯規和黃牌的分布顛倒：預測客隊犯規 14.5、黃牌 3.0，實際主隊犯規 16、黃牌 3，客隊只有 1 張。主隊落後後急於追分，犯規和黃牌集中在下半場（58'、70'、83'），模型沒有考慮比分落後對紀律的影響。
16421112.lesson: When a favourite is missing its main strikers against a deep low block, trim the home-win probability below the market and give more weight to the draw and low-scoring away wins; for cards, expect the trailing home side to foul more when chasing.
16421112.verdict_en: Outcome called completely wrong: the 63% home favourite lost 0-1. Athletic Club controlled the game but couldn't score, and Espanyol held firm and stole the win with one chance.
points_en: Wrong result: home win at 63%, away win only 14%. Athletic Club out-created them (xG 1.17 vs 0.46, shots 16 vs 6), so the dominance was real but the finishing wasn't. Missing strikers Guruzeta and Sannadi hurt more than we allowed for.
HT 0-0 was correct. The half-time update raised the draw to 39% and made 0-0 the top scoreline, which was the right direction, but it still underrated the chance of an Espanyol counter-attack goal.
Corners predicted 7-3, actual 9-2: the home pressure was stronger than modelled, matching the known bias of underestimating corners when one side dominates. First-half corners (3-2) were close.

Fouls and cards came out the reverse of the forecast: we expected Espanyol to commit 14.5 fouls and take 3.0 yellows, but Athletic committed 16 fouls and took 3 yellows to Espanyol's 1. Chasing the game after going behind pushed their discipline down in the second half (58', 70', 83'), and the model doesn't account for the trailing side fouling more.
16421112.lesson_en: When a favourite is missing its main strikers against a deep low block, trim the home-win probability below the market and give more weight to the draw and low-scoring away wins; for cards, expect the trailing home side to foul more when chasing.

16421095.verdict: Deportivo 控球較多，但 Osasuna 的反擊更有效率：雙方 xG 幾乎相同，Budimir 一次把握住機會，所以賽前「半場 0-0」的預測沒有命中。
points: 比分方面：賽前預測半場 0-0、上半進球 0.6 比 0.4。實際雙方 xG 都在 0.87 左右，射門 7 比 7，場面大致均衡。Osasuna 在 32 分鐘由 Budimir 進球，主要是把握機會的能力比較好，Deportivo 並沒有被壓制。
角球方面：預測 2.3 比 1.7，實際 3 比 1，方向正確。Deportivo 控球 60%，因此多拿了角球。
犯規和黃牌方面：預測犯規 5.6 比 6.4，實際 2 比 7。Osasuna 犯規偏多的判斷正確，但 Deportivo 的犯規明顯比預期少，因為他們一直控球，很少需要逼搶。黃牌實際 0 比 1（M. Gómez），和預測的 0.7 比 0.7 接近。
16421095.headline: 下半場 Deportivo 預計會全力壓上，角球和射門會明顯增加；Osasuna 會退守打反擊。裁判 Jon Ander Gonzalez Esteban 執法較嚴，黃牌可能集中在下半場。
16421095.changes: 勝平負：賽前 46/29/25，現在改為 16/27/57，因為客隊已經領先 1 球，而且 Deportivo 的進攻效率本來就一般。最可能比分由 1-0 改為 1-1，其次是 0-1。全場角球：主隊由 5.6 上調到 6.8，客隊由 3.8 下調到 2.8，因為落後的主隊會持續進攻。全場犯規：主隊由 12.0 下調到 8.0，因為上半場只有 2 次犯規；客隊由 13.0 微調到 13.5，因為 Osasuna 退守時需要用犯規阻止進攻。黃牌總數維持在 4.3 張左右：主隊由 2.0 下調到 1.6，客隊由 2.6 微調到 2.7。這只是根據數據的參考，不是投注建議。
16421095.verdict_en: Deportivo had more of the ball, but Osasuna's counter-attacks were more efficient: the xG was almost level, Budimir took his one chance, and the pre-match 0-0 half-time call missed.
points_en: Score: we predicted 0-0 at half-time with first-half goals of 0.6 vs 0.4. Both sides had about 0.87 xG and 7 shots each, so the half was fairly even. Osasuna scored through Budimir in the 32nd minute mainly because they finished better; Deportivo were not outplayed.
Corners: predicted 2.3 vs 1.7, actual 3 vs 1, so the direction was right. Deportivo's 60% possession earned them the extra corners.

Fouls and cards: predicted fouls 5.6 vs 6.4, actual 2 vs 7. We were right that Osasuna would foul more, but Deportivo fouled far less than expected because they kept the ball and rarely had to press. Yellow cards were 0 vs 1 (M. Gómez), close to the predicted 0.7 vs 0.7.
16421095.headline_en: Expect Deportivo to push forward in the second half, with clearly more corners and shots, while Osasuna sit deep and counter. Referee Jon Ander Gonzalez Esteban is strict, so cards may come mostly after the break.
16421095.changes_en: Win/draw/loss moves from 46/29/25 before the match to 16/27/57, because the away side already leads by a goal and Deportivo's attack has not been very efficient. The most likely score changes from 1-0 to 1-1, with 0-1 second. Full-time corners: Deportivo up from 5.6 to 6.8 and Osasuna down from 3.8 to 2.8, as the trailing home side keeps attacking. Full-time fouls: Deportivo down from 12.0 to 8.0 after only 2 in the first half; Osasuna up slightly from 13.0 to 13.5, as defending deep will mean more fouls to stop attacks. The total stays around 4.3 yellow cards: Deportivo down from 2.0 to 1.6, Osasuna up slightly from 2.6 to 2.7. This is a data-based reference only, not betting advice.

16421102.verdict: 半場 0-0 和賽前預測一樣，但比賽走勢和預期相反：Elche 機會品質明顯更好（xG 1.05 對 0.37），被看好的 Real Betis 進攻沒有威脅。
points: 半場比分 0-0 猜中，上半場沒有進球也和預測的 0.4/0.6 相符。不過 Elche 8 次射門、2 次絕佳機會，xG 1.05，卻沒有一腳射正，只是運氣和終結能力問題；Real Betis 只有 3 次射門，Isco、Antony、Fornals 的組合沒有打出預期的壓制。
角球大幅低估：預測 1.8/2.0，實際 5/3，主隊多次在邊路突破後製造角球，控球 50/50 也顯示比賽比預想均勢。
犯規和黃牌都偏高估：犯規預測 6.0/5.8，實際 4/5；黃牌預測 0.9/0.6，實際 0 張。上半場節奏開放但不粗暴，裁判 Soto Grado 一張牌都沒出。
16421102.headline: 下半場只剩約 45 分鐘可以分出勝負，Elche 機會更多但射門不準，Real Betis 個人能力較強，平局機率最高，任何一個進球都可能決定比賽。
16421102.changes: 客勝從 50% 降到 31.5%，主勝 25% 升到 27.5%，平局 25% 升到 41%：一是上半場 0-0 讓剩餘時間減半，二是 Elche 表現比預期好，所以 Real Betis 的優勢縮小。最可能比分改成 0-0。角球因上半場已有 8 個，上調到 7.5/5.5；犯規和黃牌因上半場偏少，下調到 10.0/11.0 和 1.3/1.3。大 2.5 球只剩 13%。以上僅供參考。
16421102.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted, but the flow was the opposite of what we expected: Elche created the better chances (xG 1.05 vs 0.37) while the favourites Real Betis posed little threat.
points_en: The 0-0 HT score was right, and no goals fits the predicted 0.4/0.6. But Elche had 8 shots and 2 big chances (xG 1.05) without a single shot on target, which is bad finishing and luck. Real Betis managed only 3 shots; Isco, Antony and Fornals did not produce the expected control.
Corners were badly underestimated: we predicted 1.8/2.0, the actual count was 5/3 as Elche broke down the flanks repeatedly. The 50/50 possession shows the game was more even than expected.
Fouls and cards came in lower than predicted: fouls 4/5 vs 6.0/5.8, cards 0 vs 0.9/0.6. The half was open but not rough, and referee Soto Grado showed no cards.
16421102.headline_en: With about 45 minutes left, Elche have more chances but no accuracy and Real Betis have more individual quality. A draw is now the most likely result, and one goal could decide it.
16421102.changes_en: Away win cut from 50% to 31.5%, home win up from 25% to 27.5%, draw up from 25% to 41%. Two reasons: the 0-0 at the break halves the time left, and Elche played better than expected, so Real Betis's edge is smaller. Most likely score is now 0-0. Corners raised to 7.5/5.5 because 8 were taken in the first half. Fouls cut to 10.0/11.0 and cards to 1.3/1.3 after a quiet half. Over 2.5 goals is only 13%. For reference only.

16421103.verdict: Málaga 控球只有 43%，但大機會 3 比 1、xG 0.61 比 0.28，靠反擊效率 1-0 領先；賽前預測的半場 0-0 沒有猜中。
points: 半場比分：預測 0-0，實際 1-0。Málaga 上半進球預測 0.6，實際 1 球，大致合理；Racing Club 預測 0.6 球，實際只有 1 次射正、xG 0.28，進攻比預期差。
犯規和黃牌：Málaga 犯規 6 次，接近預測的 6.4；Racing Club 只有 3 次，遠低於預測的 6.9，主要因為他們控球較多，很少需要防守犯規。黃牌是 Málaga 2 張、Racing Club 1 張，主隊比預測的 1.1 張多。
角球 2 比 1，略低於預測的 2.5 比 1.9。Málaga 24 分鐘因傷換人，這是賽前看不到的變數；Dotor 28 分鐘進球後，主隊更專心防守反擊。
16421103.headline: 下半場 Racing Club 會壓上搶進球，Málaga 退守打反擊，角球會偏向客隊；主隊已經有兩名球員吃黃牌，防守時要更小心。
16421103.changes: 勝平負從 39/27/34 改為 63/24/13，因為主隊領先而且上半場機會品質較好。最可能比分改為 1-0。全場角球改為 4.1 比 4.4，因為客隊落後要壓上。Racing Club 全場犯規從 13.6 下調到 9.2，因為他們上半場只犯規 3 次，又多數時間控球。Málaga 黃牌上調到 3.1，Racing Club 下調到 2.4。
16421103.verdict_en: Málaga had only 43% possession but led 3-1 on big chances and 0.61-0.28 on xG, and their efficient counter-attacking earned a 1-0 lead; the predicted 0-0 half-time score was wrong.
points_en: Half-time score: predicted 0-0, actual 1-0. Málaga's 0.6 first-half goal expectation was roughly right (they scored 1); Racing Club were expected to score 0.6 but managed only 1 shot on target and 0.28 xG, so their attack was worse than expected.

Fouls and cards: Málaga committed 6 fouls, close to the predicted 6.4; Racing Club committed only 3, far below the predicted 6.9, mainly because they had more of the ball and rarely needed to foul. Cards were 2 for Málaga and 1 for Racing Club, so the home side got more than the predicted 1.1.

Corners were 2-1, slightly below the predicted 2.5-1.9. Málaga made an injury substitution at 24', which the pre-match model could not see; after Dotor scored at 28', the home side focused more on defending and countering.
16421103.headline_en: In the second half Racing Club will push forward for a goal while Málaga sit back and counter, so corners should tilt toward the visitors; two Málaga players are already booked and must be careful when defending.
16421103.changes_en: 1X2 moved from 39/27/34 to 63/24/13 because the home side lead and created the better chances in the first half. The most likely score is now 1-0. Full-time corners are now 4.1-4.4 because the trailing visitors will push forward. Racing Club's full-time fouls were cut from 13.6 to 9.2, since they committed only 3 in the first half and had the ball most of the time. Málaga's yellow cards were raised to 3.1 and Racing Club's cut to 2.4.

16421104.verdict: 上半場 0-0 符合賽前判斷，Celta 明顯壓制（xG 1.2 對 0.06），但只有 1 腳射正，還有 7 次越位，一直沒把機會變成進球
points: 半場 0-0、上半進球 0.6/0.4、角球 2.0/1.7（實際 2/1）、黃牌 0.5/0.6（實際 0/1）基本都對；犯規預測 5.3/6.2，實際 4/7，Levante 犯規略多
Celta 控球 63%，射門 10 對 2，有 2 次絕佳機會，但只有 1 腳射正。27' P. Durán 的進球經 VAR 檢查後比分仍是 0-0，加上 7 次越位，說明 Celta 的前鋒反越位時機太急
Levante 全隊退守，進攻幾乎沒有威脅（xG 0.06、0 射正）。32' D. Requena 已有黃牌，下半場防守動作會收斂一些
16421104.headline: 下半場預計仍是 Celta 圍攻、Levante 死守反擊；Celta 只要提高射正率，1-0 小勝的機會不小，但 Levante 很可能一直守到底
16421104.changes: 主勝從 50% 降到 46%，平局從 27% 升到 39%，客勝從 23% 降到 15%：只剩 45 分鐘，比分仍是 0-0，所以平局機率上升；不過 Levante 進攻很弱，客勝機率也跟著下降。最可能比分從 1-0 改為 0-0。全場角球從 4.3/3.9 改為 5.0/2.8，因為 Celta 一面倒進攻；Levante 犯規預測上調到 13.5，黃牌上調到 2.0，因為他們上半場犯規和黃牌都比較多。大 2.5 球只有 13%（比賽中模型推算，賽前沒有這個欄位）
16421104.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time as predicted. Celta dominated (xG 1.2 vs 0.06) but managed only one shot on target and were caught offside seven times.
points_en: The 1H calls were mostly right: HT 0-0, 1H goals 0.6/0.4, corners 2.0/1.7 (actual 2/1), yellows 0.5/0.6 (actual 0/1). Fouls were predicted at 5.3/6.2 vs 4/7, so Levante fouled slightly more than expected.

Celta had 63% possession, out-shot Levante 10 to 2 and created 2 big chances, but only 1 shot was on target. After a VAR check on P. Durán's goal in the 27th minute the score stayed 0-0, and the 7 offsides show their forwards were timing their runs too early.
Levante sat deep and offered almost nothing going forward (xG 0.06, no shots on target). D. Requena was booked in the 32nd minute, so his tackling should be more careful after the break.
16421104.headline_en: Expect more Celta pressure against a deep Levante block in the second half. A narrow 1-0 Celta win is quite possible if they improve their finishing, but Levante may well hold out until the end.
16421104.changes_en: Home win drops from 50% to 46%, draw rises from 27% to 39% and away win drops from 23% to 15%: with only 45 minutes left at 0-0 the draw becomes more likely, and Levante's weak attack also lowers their chances. The most likely score changes from 1-0 to 0-0. Full-time corners move from 4.3/3.9 to 5.0/2.8 because Celta's attacking is one-sided. Levante's fouls go up to 13.5 and their yellows to 2.0, since they already had more fouls and a booking in the first half. Over 2.5 goals is only 13% (an in-play estimate; there was no pre-match figure for this).

16421105.verdict: Real Madrid 上半場全面壓制，控球 74%、xG 0.76 對 0.06，在 Valverde 和 Güler 進球後半場已領先 0-2，比賽方向基本已定。
points: 半場比分預測 0-1，實際 0-2；結果方向對，但 Real Madrid 上半場進了 2 球，多於預測的 1.0 球。28' 和 36' 兩個進球都在中段，Valencia 的 5-3-2 密集防守在 10 分鐘內就被打破。
角球（實際 1 比 3，預測 1.4 比 3.2）和黃牌（實際 1 比 1，預測 0.9 比 0.7）都很接近，模型預測得準。
最大偏差是犯規：Valencia 上半場犯規 13 次，預測只有 5.8 次。他們控球只有 26%，只能不斷犯規去切斷 Real Madrid 的推進，Maffeo 26' 已經吃到黃牌。
16421105.headline: 下半場 Valencia 必須壓上，但上半場 xG 只有 0.06，進攻乏力；Real Madrid 大機率控制節奏，打反擊時還有機會擴大比分。
16421105.changes: 客勝由 72% 上調到 95.7%，最可能比分維持 0-2，但 0-3 的機會上升；Valencia 全場犯規由 13.0 次大幅上調到 20.5 次（上半場已經 13 次）；黃牌略為上調到 2.4 比 2.0；角球改為 3.5 比 5.5，Valencia 壓上後角球會稍多一點。
16421105.verdict_en: Real Madrid dominated the first half (74% possession, xG 0.76 vs 0.06) and lead 0-2 through Valverde and Güler; the match is all but decided.
points_en: We predicted 0-1 at half-time and it is 0-2: right direction, but Real Madrid scored 2 first-half goals against our 1.0. Goals in the 28th and 36th minutes broke Valencia's 5-3-2 low block within 10 minutes of each other.
Corners (1 vs 3; predicted 1.4 vs 3.2) and yellow cards (1 vs 1; predicted 0.9 vs 0.7) were close to the prediction.
The big miss was fouls: Valencia committed 13 against our 5.8. With only 26% of the ball they kept fouling to stop Real Madrid's build-up, and Maffeo was booked in the 26th minute.
16421105.headline_en: Valencia must push forward, but with a first-half xG of 0.06 they have shown little threat; Real Madrid should control the tempo and may add more on the counter.
16421105.changes_en: Away win raised from 72% to 95.7%. 0-2 is still the most likely score, but 0-3 is now more likely. Valencia's full-time fouls raised sharply from 13.0 to 20.5 (they already have 13). Cards nudged up to 2.4 vs 2.0. Corners now 3.5 vs 5.5, with Valencia earning a few more as they push forward.

16421106.verdict: 上半場 0-0，雙方 xG 都只有 0.25。Osasuna 控球較少但射門更多，比賽偏膠著，犯規比預期多。
points: 半場比分 0-0 和上半場進球（預測 0.4、0.6）都基本猜中。Osasuna 射門 9 次、Athletic Club 5 次，但雙方 xG 都只有 0.25，射正合計只有 3 次，大多是遠射或低質量機會，兩邊門前都缺乏威脅。
上半場角球 2-2。Osasuna 比預測的 1.7 略多，Athletic Club 比預測的 2.8 少。Athletic Club 有 56% 控球，但沒有把控球轉化成邊路壓制，Nico Williams 和 Iñaki Williams 的突破沒有帶來足夠的角球。
上半場犯規 8-7，高於預測的 6.6、5.5，符合 derby 對抗激烈和裁判 Miguel Sesma Espinosa 尺度偏嚴的預期。黃牌目前只有 Moncayola 在第 45 分鐘吃到一張，與預測（0.9、0.6）大致相符，Athletic Club 暫時沒有黃牌。
16421106.headline: 下半場進球通常會多一些，但雙方 xG 都很低，一個進球就可能決定勝負。Athletic Club 的板凳深度不足，Osasuna 主場防守穩固，平局機率最高。
16421106.changes: 平局機率由賽前的 28% 升到 39.5%，Athletic Club 勝率由 45% 降到 33%，因為上半場 0-0 而且雙方機會質量都很低，剩下時間不多。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 0-0。大 2.5 球降到約 14%，雙方都進球降到約 23%。全場犯規上調到 15.0、13.5，因為上半場對抗已經偏激烈。角球大致維持，Osasuna 略升、Athletic Club 略降。黃牌總數維持約 4 張：Moncayola 已有黃牌會收斂，但 derby 下半場通常還會再出牌。
16421106.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time and both sides have only 0.25 xG. Osasuna have less of the ball but more shots; a cagey half with more fouls than expected.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score and the first-half goal expectations (0.4/0.6) were essentially right. Osasuna had 9 shots to Athletic Club's 5, but each side has only 0.25 xG and there were just 3 shots on target in total. Most attempts were low-quality, and neither side really threatened.

First-half corners finished 2-2: Osasuna slightly above the 1.7 forecast, Athletic Club below the 2.8 forecast. Athletic Club had 56% possession but did not turn it into pressure down the flanks, so Nico Williams and Iñaki Williams produced few corners.

First-half fouls were 8-7, above the 6.6/5.5 forecast, which fits the derby intensity and Miguel Sesma Espinosa's strict reputation. The only card so far is Moncayola's yellow (45'), broadly in line with the forecast (0.9/0.6); Athletic Club have no bookings yet.
16421106.headline_en: Second halves usually bring more goals, but chance quality is very low, so a single goal may decide it. Athletic Club's bench is thin and Osasuna are solid at home, so a draw is the most likely result.
16421106.changes_en: Draw probability raised from 28% to 39.5% and Athletic Club's win chance cut from 45% to 33%, because it is 0-0 with very low chance quality and less time left. Most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0. Over 2.5 drops to about 14% and BTTS to about 23%. Full-time fouls raised to 15.0/13.5 because the first half was already physical. Corners roughly unchanged (Osasuna slightly up, Athletic Club slightly down). Cards kept at about 4 in total: Moncayola is on a yellow and should be more careful, but derbies usually bring more cards after the break.

16421107.verdict: 上半場預測大致準確：0-0 半場比分說中，Real Sociedad 控球和射門占優但沒有一腳射正，Rayo Vallecano 反而創造了全場唯一的絕佳機會。
points: 半場 0-0 和預測一致；上半場進球預期 [0.7, 0.5]，實際 xG 為 0.59 對 0.36，相當接近。Real Sociedad 射門 9 次卻 0 次射正，正好印證賽前的判斷：Oyarzabal 不在首發，Óskarsson、Kubo、Barrenetxea 的鋒線臨門效率偏弱。
角球 3-2，預測是 3.6-1.6，主隊壓制的方向判斷對了，但 Rayo Vallecano 的反擊比預期多拿了角球；犯規 5-4，比預測的 5.9-5.6 少，比賽節奏不算激烈。
黃牌 0-1（34' Tsitaishvili），大致符合預測；Rayo Vallecano 有 1 次絕佳機會，加上門將沒有撲救壓力，說明客隊休息 8 天的體能優勢讓他們反擊有威脅。
16421107.headline: 下半場 Real Sociedad 仍會主導控球，但射正乏力，加上體能落後（距上一場只有 2.9 天），1-0 小勝或 0-0 平局是主要劇本；Rayo Vallecano 靠反擊爭取偷襲。
16421107.changes: 賽前主勝 53%，現在降到 37.6%，平局由 24% 升到 40.4%：上半場 0-0，剩下的時間只能按下半場進球預期約 0.75 對 0.5 計算，而且主隊沒有射正，最可能比分由 1-1 改成 0-0。全場角球改為 6.6-4.4（客隊上半場角球比預期多）；犯規下調到 11.5-10.0，因為上半場節奏偏慢；黃牌改為 1.2-2.2，客隊已有 1 張，主隊預期下調。
16421107.verdict_en: The first-half forecast was broadly right: the 0-0 half-time score was spot on, and Real Sociedad dominated possession and shots but did not hit the target once, while Rayo Vallecano created the only big chance.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score matched the prediction, and the forecast first-half goals [0.7, 0.5] were close to the actual xG of 0.59 vs 0.36. Real Sociedad had 9 shots and 0 on target, which backs up the pre-match view that without Oyarzabal starting, the Óskarsson/Kubo/Barrenetxea front line would be poor at finishing.

Corners were 3-2 against a predicted 3.6-1.6. We were right that the home side would dominate, but Rayo's counters won more corners than expected. Fouls were 5-4, below the predicted 5.9-5.6, because the game was not very intense.
Cards were 0-1 (Tsitaishvili, 34'), roughly in line with the forecast. Rayo had a big chance, and their 8 days' rest made their counter-attacks dangerous.
16421107.headline_en: Real Sociedad should keep most of the ball after the break, but they are not testing the keeper and they are more tired (only 2.9 days since their last match). A narrow 1-0 home win or a 0-0 draw are the most likely outcomes, while Rayo look to steal one on the counter.
16421107.changes_en: Home win drops from 53% to 37.6% and the draw rises from 24% to 40.4%. With 0-0 at half-time, only the second-half goal expectation (about 0.75 vs 0.5) is left to play for, and the home side have no shots on target, so the most likely score changes from 1-1 to 0-0. Full-time corners are now 6.6-4.4 (the away side won more corners than expected in the first half). Fouls are cut to 11.5-10.0 because the first half was slow. Cards are now 1.2-2.2: the away side already have one, and the home side's estimate is lowered.

16421108.verdict: 賽前預測的半場 0-0 猜對了；Espanyol 控球 67% 卻沒有威脅，反而是 Deportivo 製造了 2 次絕佳機會（Big chances），xG 也略高。
points: 半場比分 0-0、上半場兩隊各一張黃牌，都和預測（上半進球 0.6/0.5、黃牌 1.0/0.8）大致相符；Espanyol 控球雖多，射門只有 4 次、xG 0.24，進攻效率很低。
角球方向猜對（Deportivo 較多），但幅度低估了：實際 1-4，預測 1.6-2.4。Deportivo 靠反擊和定位球拿到更多角球。
犯規 9-3，比預測的 7.2-5.4 更偏向 Espanyol：Espanyol 防守 Deportivo 反擊時多次用犯規阻止，Deportivo 則很少犯規，這點模型沒有預料到。
16421108.headline: 下半場進球通常較多，但兩隊上半場合計 xG 只有 0.54，預料仍是低比分；Espanyol 會繼續控球壓上，Deportivo 打反擊的威脅更大，平局機會最高。
16421108.changes: 平局由 29% 升到 40%，主勝由 40% 降到 31%，客勝由 31% 降到 29%：上半場 0-0、只剩 45 分鐘，加上 Espanyol 空有控球沒有機會。最可能比分改成 0-0。全場角球改為 3.8-6.6（原 3.5-5.7），因為 Deportivo 上半場已有 4 個；犯規改為 15.5-8.5（原 15.0-11.0），因為 Deportivo 犯規明顯偏少；黃牌改為 2.4-2.0（原 2.9-2.3），因為已有黃牌的 R. Fernández 和 L. Cruz 下半場會收斂。
16421108.verdict_en: The 0-0 half-time call was correct; Espanyol had 67% possession but little threat, while Deportivo created the only 2 big chances and had slightly higher xG.
points_en: The 0-0 HT score and one yellow card each matched the forecast (1H goals 0.6/0.5, yellows 1.0/0.8); Espanyol had only 4 shots and 0.24 xG despite all the ball.
We got the direction of corners right (Deportivo had more) but underestimated the gap: actual 1-4 vs predicted 1.6-2.4, as Deportivo won corners from counters and set pieces.
Fouls were 9-3, more one-sided than the predicted 7.2-5.4: Espanyol kept fouling to stop Deportivo's counters, while Deportivo barely fouled at all, which the model did not foresee.
16421108.headline_en: Second halves usually have more goals, but the combined first-half xG was only 0.54, so a low score is still likely; Espanyol will keep the ball and push, Deportivo look more dangerous on the break, and a draw is the most likely result.
16421108.changes_en: Draw up from 29% to 40%, home win down from 40% to 31%, away win from 31% to 29%: it is 0-0 with only 45 minutes left and Espanyol's possession is producing nothing. Most likely score is now 0-0. FT corners revised to 3.8-6.6 (was 3.5-5.7) since Deportivo already have 4; fouls to 15.5-8.5 (was 15.0-11.0) as Deportivo foul far less than expected; yellows to 2.4-2.0 (was 2.9-2.3) as booked players R. Fernández and L. Cruz will be more careful.

16421109.verdict: 半場 0-0 預測命中。Sevilla 控球 62%，xG 0.94 對 0.19，明顯壓制對手，但只有 1 次射正，沒能把機會轉成進球。
points: 半場比分 0-0 和上半場進球預估（合計約 1.0）方向正確。Sevilla 有 1 次絕佳機會，但射正只有 1 次，終結能力不足，和賽前「缺少輪換前鋒、進攻厚度下降」的判斷吻合。
上半場角球只有 1-1，低於預估的 2.0/1.6。Sevilla 雖然控球佔優，但進攻大多沒有打到底線，Alavés 也很少反擊。
Alavés 犯規 10 次，明顯高於預估的 6.6，靠犯規拖慢 Sevilla 的節奏。黃牌只有 P. Ibáñez 1 張，比預估的合計 1.7 張少，Bestard 上半場執法比他的平均值寬鬆。
16421109.headline: 下半場預計 Sevilla 繼續圍攻，Alavés 會收縮防守、靠犯規阻斷進攻。Sevilla 有機會打進 1 球，但如果終結還是不足，比賽很可能以 0-0 或一球小勝收場。
16421109.changes: 主勝從 49% 降到 41%，平局從 28% 升到 40%：只剩 45 分鐘，0-0 的比分讓平局機率大增。最可能比分從 1-0 改為 0-0，大 2.5 球降到約 11%，雙方進球降到約 17%。Alavés 的全場犯規從 13 次調高到 18 次，黃牌調高到 2.4 張，反映他們上半場頻繁犯規，而 Bestard 場均黃牌偏多，下半場可能收緊尺度。全場角球下調到 3.8/2.6，因為上半場角球偏少。（僅供參考）
16421109.verdict_en: The 0-0 half-time call was right. Sevilla dominated with 62% possession and xG 0.94 vs 0.19, but had only one shot on target and could not turn pressure into a goal.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score and the first-half goal estimate (about 1.0 total) were on track. Sevilla had one big chance but only one shot on target, which fits the pre-match concern that missing backup strikers would thin out their attack.
First-half corners were only 1-1, below the 2.0/1.6 forecast. Sevilla had the ball but rarely reached the byline, and Alavés seldom countered.

Alavés committed 10 fouls, well above the 6.6 forecast, using fouls to slow Sevilla down. There was only one booking (P. Ibáñez) against about 1.7 expected, so Bestard was more lenient than his average in the first half.
16421109.headline_en: Sevilla should keep up the siege after the break while Alavés sit deep and foul to break up attacks. Sevilla may find one goal, but if their finishing stays poor, the most likely outcomes are 0-0 or a narrow one-goal win.
16421109.changes_en: Home win falls from 49% to 41% and the draw rises from 28% to 40%: with 45 minutes left at 0-0, a draw is much more likely. The most likely score moves from 1-0 to 0-0, Over 2.5 drops to about 11%, and BTTS to about 17%. Alavés' full-time fouls go up from 13 to 18 and their cards to 2.4, because they fouled heavily in the first half and Bestard usually shows plenty of cards, so he may tighten up after the break. Full-time corners drop to 3.8/2.6 after the low first-half count. (Reference only.)

16421110.verdict: 上半場和賽前預想的一樣：Villarreal 全面壓制，但還沒進球，0-0 的半場比分猜中了；Getafe 幾乎沒有進攻能力。
points: 半場 0-0 預測正確。Villarreal 控球 75%、射門 9 比 2、xG 0.65 比 0.14，進球預期 0.8 比 0.3 方向正確，只是 Villarreal 2 次射正、1 次絕佳機會沒能把握住，Getafe 一次射正都沒有。
上半場角球 4 比 1，賽前預測 3.6 比 1.5，相當接近，說明 Villarreal 一直在對方半場壓迫。
犯規 1 比 7，Villarreal 遠少於預測的 5.4，因為一直控球，幾乎不需要防守犯規；Getafe 7 次犯規和 M. Martín 的黃牌符合 Bordalás 球隊的風格。裁判 Muniz 目前出牌寬鬆，黃牌 0 比 1 和預測的 0.5 比 1.1 一致。
16421110.headline: 下半場 Villarreal 還會繼續圍攻，關鍵是能不能攻破 Getafe 的密集防守；拖得越久，平局機率越高，一球小勝仍是最可能的結果。
16421110.changes: 主勝由 63% 降到 55%，平局由 22% 升到 33%，因為只剩 45 分鐘，還是 0-0。最可能比分改為 1-0、0-0、2-0（2-1 拿掉，Getafe 進攻太弱）。全場角球由 7.3 比 3.2 調為 8.0 比 2.8，因為壓制比預期更明顯。Villarreal 犯規由 12.4 大幅降到 6.0（控球太多，很少需要犯規）；Getafe 犯規維持高位，為 14.5。黃牌主隊由 2.0 降到 1.2，客隊由 3.4 降到 2.8，因為裁判出牌偏寬鬆，已有黃牌的 M. Martín 下半場也會收斂。
16421110.verdict_en: The first half went as expected: Villarreal dominated but couldn't score, so the 0-0 half-time call was right; Getafe offered almost nothing going forward.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time prediction was correct. Villarreal had 75% possession, 9 shots to 2 and 0.65 xG to 0.14, so the 0.8 vs 0.3 first-half goal expectation pointed the right way. They just didn't take their 2 shots on target or their one big chance, while Getafe had no shot on target at all.
First-half corners were 4-1 against a predicted 3.6-1.5, which is close and shows Villarreal camped in Getafe's half.

Fouls were 1-7, with Villarreal far below the predicted 5.4 because they kept the ball and hardly had to defend. Getafe's 7 fouls and M. Martín's yellow fit Bordalás's style. Referee Muniz has been lenient so far, and the 0-1 yellow count matches the 0.5-1.1 prediction.
16421110.headline_en: Villarreal should keep laying siege in the second half. The question is whether they can break down Getafe's low block; the longer it stays 0-0, the likelier a draw, but a narrow one-goal home win is still the most likely result.
16421110.changes_en: Home win drops from 63% to 55% and the draw rises from 22% to 33%, because it is still 0-0 with only 45 minutes left. Most likely scores are now 1-0, 0-0 and 2-0 (2-1 is dropped because Getafe's attack is so weak). Full-time corners move from 7.3-3.2 to 8.0-2.8, since the dominance is even clearer than expected. Villarreal's fouls are cut sharply from 12.4 to 6.0 (they have so much of the ball they rarely need to foul), while Getafe's stay high at 14.5. Yellows drop from 2.0 to 1.2 for the home side and from 3.4 to 2.8 for the away side, because the referee is lenient and the already-booked M. Martín will be more careful.

16421111.verdict: Alavés 上半場明顯壓制（xG 0.68 比 0.02，射門 10 比 1），卻因為 Tenaglia 的烏龍球被扳平，比分沒有反映場面。
points: 半場比分預測 0-0 錯誤：Á. Pérez 第 2 分鐘就進球，比賽很早被打開；Deportivo 全場只有 1 次射門、沒有射正，扳平的球是第 41 分鐘 Tenaglia 的烏龍球，屬於偶然因素。
上半場角球 3 比 1，主隊比預測的 2.1 多，客隊比預測的 2.0 少，符合「一方壓制時角球集中在強隊」的已知偏差；犯規 5 比 7，客隊比預測的 5.3 多，因為他們一直在防守、靠犯規破壞進攻。
黃牌 1 比 2，高於預測的 0.4 和 0.5：Deportivo 在被動防守下很早吃到兩張黃牌（Navarro、Quagliata），Á. Pérez 也已經有一張黃牌。
16421111.headline: 下半場預計 Alavés 繼續主導並尋找制勝球，Deportivo 進攻威脅很低，但在強風下可能守住平局或靠反擊偷襲。
16421111.changes: 平局機率由 30.0% 上調到 42.0%，因為已經 1-1，而且下半場剩餘的預期進球有限（主隊約 0.7、客隊約 0.4）；主勝由 42.5% 降到 39.0%，客勝由 27.5% 降到 19.0%，反映 Alavés 在場面上的優勢。首選比分改為 1-1，雙方進球已確定是 100%。主隊全場角球由 5.1 上調到 6.3，客隊由 5.1 下調到 3.4；客隊犯規由 11.5 上調到 13.5，客隊黃牌由 2.0 上調到 2.8，因為他們一直被壓著打；已有黃牌的球員下半場會收斂，所以黃牌上調幅度有限。
16421111.verdict_en: Alavés dominated the first half (xG 0.68 vs 0.02, shots 10-1) but were pegged back by a Tenaglia own goal, so the score flatters Deportivo.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was wrong: Á. Pérez scored after 2 minutes. Deportivo managed only 1 shot and none on target; their equaliser was a 41' own goal by Tenaglia, a fluke.

First-half corners went 3-1: more for the home side than the predicted 2.1 and fewer for the away side than the predicted 2.0, which fits the known bias that corners pile up for the dominant team. Fouls went 5-7: Deportivo committed more than the predicted 5.3 because they spent the half defending and fouling to break up attacks.
Yellow cards went 1-2, above the predicted 0.4/0.5: deep-defending Deportivo picked up two early bookings (Navarro, Quagliata), and Á. Pérez is also on a yellow.
16421111.headline_en: Expect Alavés to keep control and push for a winner. Deportivo offer little going forward but could hold the draw in the strong wind or nick one on the break.
16421111.changes_en: Draw raised from 30.0% to 42.0% because it is already 1-1 and only limited second-half goals are expected (about 0.7 home, 0.4 away). Home win cut from 42.5% to 39.0% and away win from 27.5% to 19.0%, reflecting Alavés' edge in play. Top score is now 1-1, and BTTS is already settled at 100%. Home corners raised from 5.1 to 6.3 and away corners cut from 5.1 to 3.4. Deportivo fouls raised from 11.5 to 13.5 and their yellows from 2.0 to 2.8, as they are pinned back. Players already on a yellow should be more careful after the break, so card increases are modest.

16421112.verdict: 上半場 0-0 和賽前預測的半場比分一致。Athletic Club 創造了較好的機會，xG 0.69 對 0.18，大機會 2 對 0，但沒有把握住。Espanyol 的深度防守暫時守住了。
points: 半場 0-0 和上半進球都預測對了。實際 xG（0.69 對 0.18）和賽前預估的上半進球 0.6 對 0.2 幾乎一致，Athletic Club 缺少 Guruzeta、Sannadi 兩名中鋒，終結能力不足，2 次大機會都沒有轉化。
角球 3 比 2，Athletic Club 少於預測的 3.8，Espanyol 多於預測的 1.3。控球 49 比 51，Athletic Club 沒有形成預期中的壓制，Espanyol 也能把球推進前場。
犯規明顯偏離預測：Athletic Club 9 次，遠高於預測的 4.5，Espanyol 7 次，接近預測。上半場沒有黃牌，低於預測的 0.4 和 0.9，說明裁判尺度寬鬆。
16421112.headline: 下半場 Athletic Club 會繼續進攻。預計 Valverde 會換上更多進攻球員，但缺少中鋒的問題還在。Espanyol 的反擊威脅很低，最可能的結果是 1-0 或 0-0。
16421112.changes: 主勝從 63% 降到 46%，平局從 23% 升到 39%，因為只剩 45 分鐘仍是 0-0，主隊終結能力差。最可能比分從 1-0 改為 0-0。Athletic Club 全場角球從 7.0 降到 6.5，Espanyol 從 3.0 升到 4.0。Athletic Club 全場犯規從 9.5 大幅上調到 15.5。上半場沒有黃牌，裁判偏寬鬆，全場黃牌略降。
16421112.verdict_en: 0-0 at half-time, as predicted. Athletic Club created the better chances (xG 0.69 vs 0.18, big chances 2-0) but failed to score, and Espanyol's deep block has held so far.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score and first-half goals were correct. Actual xG (0.69 vs 0.18) almost exactly matched the predicted 0.6 vs 0.2. Without strikers Guruzeta and Sannadi, Athletic Club lacked a finisher and wasted both big chances.

Corners were 3-2: fewer than predicted for Athletic Club (3.8) and more for Espanyol (1.3). Possession was 49-51, so Athletic Club did not dominate as expected, and Espanyol could move the ball forward.

Fouls missed badly: Athletic Club committed 9, far above the predicted 4.5, while Espanyol's 7 was close to the forecast. No yellow cards in the first half (predicted 0.4 and 0.9), so the referee is lenient.
16421112.headline_en: Athletic Club will keep attacking in the second half, and Valverde will likely bring on more attackers, but the missing striker is still a problem. Espanyol rarely threaten on the counter, so 1-0 or 0-0 is the most likely result.
16421112.changes_en: Home win cut from 63% to 46% and draw raised from 23% to 39%, because only 45 minutes remain at 0-0 and the home side finishes poorly. Most likely score changed from 1-0 to 0-0. Athletic Club full-time corners cut from 7.0 to 6.5, Espanyol raised from 3.0 to 4.0. Athletic Club full-time fouls raised sharply from 9.5 to 15.5. No first-half cards and a lenient referee, so full-time cards trimmed slightly.

rules.zh: 總進球系統性高估（11 場平均偏差 +0.91）：全場進球預期先比基準下調約 0.5 球；預期總進球低於 2.3 時，前三個比分選項必須包含 0-0 或 1-0。
rules.en: Total goals are systematically over-forecast (bias +0.91 over 11 games): cut the baseline total-goals expectation by about 0.5; when expected goals are below 2.3, the top-3 scorelines must include 0-0 or 1-0.
rules.evidence: Cumulative bias g +0.91 (MAE 1.07). Sevilla 0-0 Alavés, Espanyol 0-0 Deportivo, Celta 0-0 Levante and Real Sociedad 1-0 Rayo Vallecano all came in below forecast.

rules.zh: 平局下限：市場勝平負三項接近（最高一項低於 45%），或者佔優一方缺少前鋒輪換、終結能力差時，平局至少給 30%。xG 佔優不等於一定進球。
rules.en: Draw floor: when the market 1X2 is balanced (top outcome below 45%), or the dominant side lacks striker depth or finishing, give the draw at least 30%. xG dominance does not guarantee goals.
rules.evidence: 4 of 10 matches this round were draws: Sevilla 0-0 (xG 1.58 vs 0.54), Celta 0-0 (xG 3.04 vs 0.22), Espanyol 0-0, Osasuna 1-1 (Athletic Club xG 2.09). Pre-match draw was only about 28% in each.

rules.zh: 上半場進球高估（偏差 +0.57）：除非熱門一方勝率不低於 65%，半場首選比分一律用 0-0，上半場進球預期下調約 0.4。
rules.en: First-half goals are over-forecast (bias +0.57): unless the favourite's win probability is at least 65%, make 0-0 the default HT pick and cut the 1H goal expectation by about 0.4.
rules.evidence: 7 of 10 matches were 0-0 at HT (Sevilla, Espanyol, Osasuna, Elche, Real Sociedad, Celta, Villarreal). Villarreal, Elche and Osasuna scored after 80 minutes. Cumulative g1 bias +0.57.

rules.zh: 半場更新：0-0 時可把平局提高 8–12 個百分點，但不要只因上半場 xG 或射正落後，就把強隊或主隊的勝率降超過 15 個百分點。弱隊半場領先時，它的勝率不要調到 50% 以上。
rules.en: HT updates: at 0-0, raising the draw by 8-12 pts is fine, but don't cut the stronger or home side's win probability by more than 15 pts just because they trailed on 1H xG or shots on target. If the weaker side leads at HT, don't push its win probability above 50%.
rules.evidence: Raising the draw at HT was right in Sevilla, Espanyol, Osasuna and Celta. Overreactions were wrong in Elche-Betis (Betis won 0-2) and Real Sociedad-Rayo (Real Sociedad won 1-0). Málaga were raised to 63% after leading, then lost 1-2.

rules.zh: 犯規重新分配，不要整體加量：預期控球不超過 40%、被壓制的一方，犯規比基準加 40–80%；控球不低於 60% 的一方減 20–30%。全場犯規總數維持基準或下調約 2 次（雨天或客隊休息充足時再下調）。
rules.en: Redistribute fouls rather than inflating the total: the pinned-back side (expected possession ≤40%) gets +40-80% fouls over baseline, the side with ≥60% possession gets -20-30%. Keep the match total at baseline or about 2 lower (lower still in rain or when the away side is well rested).
rules.evidence: Pressed sides: Alavés 19 (forecast 13), Valencia 26 (forecast 13), Osasuna 19 (forecast 13.8); Real Madrid had only 6 and Villarreal 6. Totals were over-forecast in Celta-Levante (17 vs 24.2), Real Sociedad-Rayo (19 vs 24.5) and Villarreal-Getafe. Cumulative fouls MAE 6.0.

rules.zh: 黃牌分配給被壓制或落後的一方：預期控球佔優而且大概率領先的一方，黃牌不超過 1.5 張；被動或落後的一方佔總黃牌的 60–75%。
rules.en: Assign cards to the pressed or trailing side: the side expected to dominate possession and likely lead gets ≤1.5 yellows; the passive or trailing side gets 60-75% of the total.
rules.evidence: Alavés 3-1, Málaga 6-2 plus a red, Elche 4-0 (all after falling behind), Valencia picked up a red. Sevilla were forecast 2.8 cards but got 1; Real Betis were forecast 1.9 but got 0.

rules.zh: 黃牌時段後移：上半場黃牌比基準減約 0.3 張，移到下半場。預期比分膠著（平局或一球差），或者是護級戰、derby 時，下半場黃牌再加 0.5–1 張，並考慮兩黃變一紅或紅牌後失控的風險。
rules.en: Shift cards later: move about 0.3 yellows from 1H to 2H. If the score is expected to stay tight (level or one goal), or it's a relegation battle or derby, add 0.5-1 2H yellows and allow for second-yellow or post-red-card escalation.
rules.evidence: Cumulative y1 bias +0.35. Espanyol-Deportivo had 6 of 8 yellows after 73'. Elche's 4 yellows all came in the 2H. Valencia picked up 4 yellows in 79-81' after Gayà's red. Aznou was sent off for two yellows at 64' in Málaga-Racing.

rules.zh: 角球：中游以上的控球型球隊（預期控球不低於 60%）面對純防守對手時，該隊角球比本季主場平均加 1.5–2.5 個。Real Madrid 和 Barcelona 這類以中路和禁區內直接射門為主的強隊例外，不加，甚至下調。
rules.en: Corners: a possession side (expected possession ≥60%, not Real Madrid or Barcelona) facing a purely defensive opponent gets +1.5-2.5 corners over its season home average. Elite central-attacking sides (Real Madrid, Barcelona) get no boost, or get shaded down.
rules.evidence: Espanyol had 9 corners (forecast 3.5) and Villarreal 9 (13 in the match vs 10.5 forecast). Barcelona had only 2 with 63% possession (match total 6 vs 9.6), and Real Madrid had 5 (match total 7 vs 10). Cumulative corners bias -0.89.

rules.zh: 中下游球隊主場對強隊，而且雙方都以邊路和傳中為主時，全場角球基準上調 2–3 個。主場弱隊控球少但射門多時，主隊角球不要低於客隊。
rules.en: For a lower/mid-table home side vs a stronger team where both play wide and cross, raise the match corner baseline by 2-3. When a weak home side has little possession but shoots a lot, don't forecast fewer home corners than away corners.
rules.evidence: Elche-Betis had 17 corners vs 9.4 forecast. In Osasuna-Athletic Club, Osasuna took 17 shots and won 6 corners although the forecast favoured the away side.

rules.zh: 裁判的本季平均黃牌數要和聯賽平均 50/50 混合後才使用。兩支強隊對碰時，嚴格裁判的加成再減半。球隊的粗野名聲權重要低於裁判的實際數據。
rules.en: Blend the referee's season card average 50/50 with the league average before using it, and halve a strict referee's uplift in big-team head-to-heads. Weight team 'dirty' reputation below the referee's actual data.
rules.evidence: Atlético-Barcelona under strict Alberola Rojas: 4 yellows (forecast 4.8) and 28 fouls (his average 32). In Villarreal-Getafe, lenient Muniz mattered more than Bordalás's reputation: Getafe got 2 yellows vs 3.4 forecast.

playbook.summary_zh: 第一次建立西甲守則（10 條）：重點是下調總進球和上半場進球、提高平局和 0-0 的機率、把犯規和黃牌改為分配給被壓制或落後的一方、黃牌時段往下半場移，角球則按球隊打法分別上調或下調。
playbook.summary_en: First La Liga playbook (10 rules): cut total and first-half goals, raise draw/0-0 probability, assign fouls and cards to the pressed or trailing side and shift cards to the 2H, and adjust corners up or down depending on team style.
